protocol.name: reprise_reopen_v1
protocol.copyright: reprise private protocol: what a program's window starts again with at session restore.

interface.name: reprise_reopen_v1

description.summary: name the argument that opens a toplevel again

interface.description: One global. A program names, for each of its toplevels, the one command-line argument that opens that window again as it is now: a file, a folder, a page. Session restore keeps it with the session and, at the next login, starts the program's desktop entry once per argument its windows named, the argument in place of the entry's file field code, or after its command line when it has none.

request.name: set
request.description: Asked before toplevel maps, it holds from the map on. Null, an empty string, one over 1024 bytes or one holding a control character names none, and the window starts again as the entry starts with no file. Ignored when toplevel belongs to another client.
